note: Egypt advertising & exhibitions calendar (/egypt-advertising-calendar/). 'start'/'end' only when the date comes from the organiser or several listings agree; otherwise 'month' only and tbc:true. Religious seasons follow the Hijri calendar and are placed in their expected month, without a Gregorian date. Update every few months.

items.en: Egypt's biggest TV season, when families watch together after iftar. Expected to start in February; the date follows the moon sighting.
